title: 60" Round Table Seating Guide — Capacity and Layouts
description: Learn how many guests comfortably fit at a 60-inch round table and explore the best layout ideas for your wedding reception.
aeo_answer: A 60-inch round table can comfortably seat 8 guests. While you can fit 10 guests maximum, it will feel tight and limit table decor. It is the most common and versatile table size for wedding receptions.
cons: Takes up more floor space per guest than long tables

faqs.question: How many chairs fit around a 60-inch round table?
faqs.answer: You can comfortably fit 8 chairs around a 60-inch round table. Pushing it to 10 chairs is possible but will be cramped.

faqs.question: What size tablecloth do I need for a 60-inch round table?
faqs.answer: For a floor-length drop, you will need a 120-inch round tablecloth. For a lap-length drop, a 90-inch round tablecloth works well.

title: 72" Round Table Seating Guide — Guests, Layouts & Spacing
description: Discover the optimal seating arrangements and capacity for 72-inch round banquet tables at your wedding or event.
aeo_answer: A 72-inch round table comfortably seats 10 guests. You can maximize it to 12 guests for a tighter fit, or seat 8 for a more spacious, formal dining experience. It's ideal for large ballrooms.
best_for: Maximizing guest count with fewer tables
pros: Reduces total number of tables needed
cons: Harder for guests across the table to converse

faqs.question: How many people does a 72-inch round table seat?
faqs.answer: A 72-inch round table seats 10 people comfortably, but can hold up to 12 if you are trying to maximize space.

faqs.question: What size linen goes on a 72-inch round table?
faqs.answer: You need a 132-inch round linen to reach the floor on a standard 30-inch high 72-inch round table.

title: 8ft Long Table Seating Guide — Family Style Layouts
description: Everything you need to know about seating guests at 8-foot long rectangular tables, from capacity to centerpiece ideas.
aeo_answer: An 8-foot long rectangular table comfortably seats 8 guests (4 on each side). You can fit 10 guests if you add one chair to each end. This table style is perfect for rustic, family-style dining.
pros: Creates an intimate, communal dining feel
Great for garland or runner-style centerpieces
cons: Conversation is limited to immediate neighbors
Can feel crowded with lots of glassware and plates

faqs.question: How many people can sit at an 8-foot rectangular table?
faqs.answer: An 8-foot rectangular table seats 8 to 10 people. You can seat 4 on each long side, and optionally 1 on each end.

faqs.question: Can you put two 8-foot tables together?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can line them up end-to-end to create extra-long banquet tables, which is very popular for modern and rustic weddings.
